vsm2.17:193.1: “This means, due to the heat element in the materiality that arose together with the rebirth-linking consciousness. It is because the heart-basis is arisen only at that very moment, that there is weakness of the physical basis” (Vism-mhṭ 622).
vsm2.17:196.3: Vāhanika—“having a float”: not in PED. The context suggests a catamaran, universal in Indian waters.
vsm2.17:197.3: The expression “ekadesasarūpekasesa” is grammatically explained at Vism-mhṭ 623; see allied expressions, “katekasesa” (§204) and “ekasese kate” (§223). Cf. Pāṇini I 2, 64.
